Scrabble Score Calculator

Scrabble Score Calculator — real English tile values with double/triple letter and word bonuses plus the 50-point bingo.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your word (letters only).
  2. Set DL/TL on any premium letter squares.
  3. Set DW/TW if the word covers premium word squares.
  4. Tick bingo if you used all 7 tiles, then Calculate.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which tile values do you use?

A1 B3 C3 D2 E1 F4 G2 H4 I1 J8 K5 L1 M3 N1 O1 P3 Q10 R1 S1 T1 U1 V4 W4 X8 Y4 Z2 — standard English Scrabble tile values.

In what order do bonuses apply?

Letter bonuses (DL/TL) apply to individual tiles first, then the whole word total is multiplied by any word bonuses (DW/TW). Two DWs quadruple the word.

What is the bingo bonus?

Using all 7 tiles in one play adds a 50-point bingo bonus — tick the checkbox when your play uses your whole rack.
